# Loan Interest Rate and Risk Management

This document outlines key directives for the 2026 strategy concerning loan management.

*   Investigate interest rates for strategy 2026.
*   Update interest rates quarterly.
*   Investigate interest rates quarterly.
*   Update collateral value quarterly.
*   Update default risk quarterly.
